text:
I need to verify if New Zealand beat American Samoa 31-0 in a 2002 World Cup qualifying match and failed to qualify.

The most famous match involving American Samoa in 2002 World Cup qualifying was their 31-0 loss to Australia on April 11, 2001. This is one of the most lopsided defeats in international football history.

Australia did fail to qualify for the 2002 World Cup despite this massive victory, losing to Uruguay in a playoff.

New Zealand also played American Samoa in the same qualifying campaign and won 5-0, not 31-0.

The proposed answer states New Zealand beat American Samoa 31-0, which is factually incorrect. It was Australia who won 31-0.
